title: Deep Learning Based on Swin-Transformer and 3D U-Net: Implant Three-Dimensional Position Planning
relation_to_project: Directly relevant to posterior mandibular implant planning with mandibular nerve canal segmentation.
limitations: Retrospective internal validation; no external center or reader-study endpoint.

title: Multi-structure segmentation in CBCT volumes: The ToothFairy2 challenge
source_type: peer-reviewed journal article and benchmark repository
relation_to_project: Benchmark data for external testing of maxillofacial CBCT segmentation, including inferior alveolar canals.
limitations: Benchmark evidence, not clinical workflow validation.

title: TAPSeg: An open-source deep learning tool for instance-level tooth and pulp segmentation in CBCT
relation_to_project: Useful design precedent for 3D Slicer integration and external testing.
limitations: Not mandibular canal; public code availability should be verified before reuse.
